C-DESKTOP-STABILIZATION.Name: Sequential integration of accepted and unfinished desktop repairs
C-DESKTOP-STABILIZATION.Summary: Execute the owner's approved preservation/integration steps 1-3: retain recovered documentation, integrate accepted FIX-001 and delivery records, finish C-71 with the existing c65cov tests, review and finish C-68, and reproduce the fullscreen/tab-close reports before any bounded repair or explicit deferral.
C-DESKTOP-STABILIZATION.ApprovalBasis: Owner 2026-10-19: steps 1, 2 and 3 approved; integrate after each task. Step 4 remains discussion only. Desktop and mobile must have independent commits and release cadence; mandatory local-model safety checks apply before every commit and push.

Goals.Goal: Integrate one reviewed desktop task at a time on current main with exact local safety review and applicable tests.
Preserve accepted FIX-001 behavior, finish table/viewer/tooltip and diff regressions within existing contracts, and distinguish integration from owner acceptance and publication.
Retain deferred product ideas without implementing them.

Constraints.Constraint: No mobile source, store action, global GRACE cleanup, large refactor, version bump, tag or publication.
Do not import raw machine-specific coverage dumps or hardcoded worktree configs. Keep approved historical implementation plans immutable.
Use the mandatory common safety hooks, one local inference engine, complete candidate review and recheck for each commit/push.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No implementation of backlog features, new local-history system or unconfirmed speculative event-handler changes.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Recovered documents are retained and each integrated repair has a separately reviewable commit and passing scoped checks.

FIX-001 preserves native vertical selection and active-picker navigation; C-71 has reproducible checks and no duplicate c65cov integration; C-68 preserves snapshot priority and tab isolation without raw no-baseline errors.
Unreproduced close reports remain explicitly recorded rather than claimed fixed; owner acceptance and release admission are recorded separately.

AffectedAreas.Area: M-011, M-012 and M-046 renderer/Muya/test infrastructure and their routed graph/verification projections.
Recovered docs, desktop release-train records, scoped integration evidence and independent existing C-68/C-71 implementation contracts.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Per-task unit/browser/build/IPC/CI results, safety receipts bound to exact payloads and accurate accepted/pending integration states.
